name: @qgis/rust
description: Bun/Turbo facade for the Cargo workspace as ONE package. Every verb is a single command that re-enters pixi's `default` environment, because the QGIS-linked crates need the CONDA_PREFIX activation that exists nowhere else. `pixi run` keeps the caller's working directory, which is this package's directory, so every command below is written relative to `crates/`. `test` runs two suites on purpose: the whole workspace with `--no-default-features`, which is every QGIS-free crate, and then `qgis-sys` + `qgis-mcp` with their `qgis` features, whose tests are `#![cfg(feature = "qgis")]` or branch on `cfg!(feature = "qgis")` and were therefore invisible to the gate. The RFC 19 phase-four claims are only proven by that second run: render_map and export_features answering from real QGIS, and capabilities reporting a loaded backend where the first run proves it reports `unavailable`. A third run, `test-cpp`, builds the native manager's own GoogleTest/RapidCheck suite with cmake and ninja and runs it under ctest: those are the manager's edge conversions — JSON envelope, handle encoding, the C ABI's malloc/free pair — which neither cargo run can reach as units because loading the manager means starting QGIS.

scripts.test: pixi run -e default setup && pixi run -e default cargo test --workspace --no-default-features -- --test-threads=1 && pixi run -e default cargo test -p qgis-sys -p qgis-mcp --features qgis-sys/qgis,qgis-mcp/qgis -- --test-threads=1 && pixi run -e default -- test-cpp
scripts.lint: bun x biome check package.json && pixi run -e default cargo fmt --all --check && pixi run -e default cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pixi run -e default cargo build -p qgis-sys && pixi run -e default -- clang-tidy
scripts.format: bun x biome format --write package.json && pixi run -e default cargo fmt --all && pixi run -e default -- format-cpp
scripts.coverage: pixi run -e default setup && mkdir -p ../target/coverage && pixi run -e default cargo llvm-cov --workspace --exclude qgis-sys --no-default-features --lcov --output-path ../target/coverage/rust-lcov.info -- --test-threads=1
